question: Does the frozen minimal layer-mean-head Feddes feedback preserve the hydrologically relevant dynamic drought-stress response of the qualified RA02R Reference, and can any discrepancy be separated from ordinary reduced-hydraulic propagation error?

minimal_feedback.representative_head: frozen inverse van Genuchten retention h(theta_bar_i)
minimal_feedback.retained_root_fraction: exact integral of the frozen SHALLOW or UNIFORM root density over retained layer i
minimal_feedback.sink: T_p * DeltaF_i * unchanged drought-only Feddes alpha(h_bar_i)
minimal_feedback.evaluation_timing: once from committed retained hydraulic state at the start of every candidate transaction
minimal_feedback.trial_treatment: sink held prescribed during the hydraulic trial

stage3_control.purpose: Provide a same-domain high-resolution no-drought-reduction hydraulic control so feedback-specific discrepancy can be separated from ordinary reduced-hydraulic propagation error.
stage3_control.reference_geometry: RA02R high-resolution routes and target R2048_T32
stage3_control.root_sink: T_p times exact fine-node root fraction; alpha fixed to 1 only for this diagnostic control
stage3_control.hydraulics: unchanged Reference Richards, boundaries and RA02R transferred numerical policy
stage3_control.qualification: same five three-level numerical uncertainty metrics and O0/O2 identity as RA02R; stress-activation gate not applicable

candidate_controls.full_potential_reduced: For every retained representation, run the same reduced hydraulics with Q_i=T_p*DeltaF_i. This is the already Stage2-qualified sink semantics and is used only to form feedback-effect differences.

primary_componentwise: actual transpiration fraction RMSE and maximum absolute error
cumulative actual root uptake RMSE and terminal error
metrics.profile_redistribution_index: At each observation, standard deviation over the 16 mapped 10-cm bins of theta_bin(t)-theta_bin(initial).
metrics.stress_definition: actual transpiration fraction < 1 - RA02R activation guard 2.9103830456733704e-11

comparator_rules.absolute_reference_distinguishability: For the five metrics covered by RA02R U_combined, report candidate-reference RMSE divided by the corresponding frozen RA02R numerical uncertainty. This is numerical distinguishability, not an application tolerance.
comparator_rules.feedback_effect_definition: DeltaX_model = X_dynamic - X_full_potential_control. Compare DeltaX_candidate with DeltaX_reference componentwise.
comparator_rules.feedback_specific_uncertainty: For metrics covered by both dynamic and full-potential Reference uncertainty, use the sum of the two independently qualified U_combined values as a conservative distinguishability bound.
comparator_rules.stress_timing_uncertainty: Derive before candidate adjudication from the fixed RA02R numerical hierarchy and S3-C0 hierarchy as the maximum target-versus-ladder onset/duration observation difference.
comparator_rules.bounded_success: Only if feedback-effect discrepancies are not numerically distinguishable on all covered primary metrics and stress activation/timing are within the frozen numerical timing uncertainty may the result say that new root-specific state is not shown necessary on this mechanistic domain.
comparator_rules.bounded_failure: If feedback-effect discrepancies are numerically distinguishable, the minimal existing-state feedback is falsified on the affected components, subject to missing-information localization.

missing_information_localization.A: Threshold-crossing information within a retained layer: stress timing/rate mismatch concentrated where layer mean stays near h3/h4 while mapped profile spans the threshold.
missing_information_localization.B: Root-weighted pressure-head distribution: uptake mismatch persists after accounting for hydraulic baseline and correlates with within-root-zone profile spread rather than layer placement alone.
missing_information_localization.C: Upper-zone spatial placement: U4/U8/R8/R16 pattern shows improvement specifically with finer 0-80 cm placement, without requiring a new root-specific memory state.
missing_information_localization.D: Hydraulic propagation: full-potential reduced-vs-Reference baseline dominates the same storage/profile/bottom components while feedback-effect difference remains within numerical uncertainty.
missing_information_localization.E: Memory/hysteresis-like information: residual feedback error depends on prior stress evolution for states with comparable current retained storages and cannot be explained by A-D.

decision_constraints: No new partition, closure, root-specific state, fitted coefficient, relaxation or correction after response.
No application tolerance derived from observed candidate errors.
If S3-C0 does not qualify, stop before dynamic reduced response.
If dynamic response fails, persist componentwise failure and localization before designing any follow-up state.
